desc:
🤥 Welcome to Liar's Table!

A community revival of the original Liar's Table by https://www.roblox.com/communities/4620969/Let-s-Make-Games#!/about
The original creator also has a remake called Fraud Watch! Check it out: https://www.roblox.com/games/94939875345141/Fraud-Watch

Use code "RELEASE" for 5K Cash and some freebies. 😉

HOW TO PLAY
🃏 Convince your opponents to believe your lies, fooling them with the wrong (or right) cards
❌ Carefully decide when to call out your opponents' potential lies
🧪 Avoid having to drink a potion, which could put you to sleep and lose you the game
🏆 Be the last one awake to win the game!
